query:
UPDATE work_items
        SET title      = COALESCE(?2, title),
            body       = COALESCE(?3, body),
            status     = COALESCE(?4, status),
            position   = COALESCE(?5, position),
            attributes = COALESCE(?6, attributes),
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
